SEN.note: Tax agency's own registration and filing platforms only; no national services portal.

facts.fact: DGID says foreign digital providers subject to the VAT under article 355 bis, in force from 1 July 2024, register remotely online and make VAT declarations through its Etax online platform, with no electronic payment channel stated.

SEN.note: Online declaration is stated; payment method and main taxes are not.

facts.fact: DGID says VAT declarations by foreign digital providers are made through its Etax online declaration platform, under rules in force from 1 July 2024.

SEN.note: Covers one tax and one taxpayer group; no payment or share filed online stated.
